title: Starfall Sentinels
description: A lone orbital lighthouse keeper defends a chain of signal buoys from drifting ember swarms that descend in orderly ranks. Each buoy saved keeps a shipping lane lit, and the keeper's lamp-cannon is the only weapon standing between the dark and the lanes.
body:
A lone orbital lighthouse keeper defends a chain of signal buoys from drifting ember swarms that descend in orderly ranks. Each buoy saved keeps a shipping lane lit, and the keeper's lamp-cannon is the only weapon standing between the dark and the lanes.

The rules are simple: the player slides a cannon along the bottom of a 7-column grid, fires upward at 3 rows of descending foes, and scores for every foe cleared before the formation reaches row 11. Clearing a full column without losing ground earns a bonus, and the run ends when the formation lands or is destroyed.

The lamp-cannon fires straight up and the ember ranks march downward, so the keeper wins by sweeping columns methodically and saving a retreat lane under the last buoy. Scoring rewards full columns cleared without losing a buoy, and a perfect sweep lights a bonus beacon.
controls: Type left/right/shoot to move and fire, quit to stop.

title: Tide of Sparks
description: Tide-wardens guard a spark-tide power station from wave-riders that descend on the incoming tide. The warden's coil-gun fires upward, and each rider turned back keeps the station's tide-gates charged.
body:
Tide-wardens guard a spark-tide power station from wave-riders that descend on the incoming tide. The warden's coil-gun fires upward, and each rider turned back keeps the station's tide-gates charged.

The rules are simple: the player slides a cannon along the bottom of a 8-column grid, fires upward at 2 rows of descending foes, and scores for every foe cleared before the formation reaches row 12. Clearing a full column without losing ground earns a bonus, and the run ends when the formation lands or is destroyed.

Wave-riders arrive with the tide's rhythm, so the warden times shots to the tide's swell rather than firing constantly. A fully charged gate discharges a bonus surge that clears the nearest rank.
controls: Type left/right/shoot to move and fire, quit to stop.

title: Hollow Suns
description: Sun-keepers tend hollow suns that hang over a desert of glass, defending them from sand-bats that descend at noon. The keeper's mirror-gun fires reflected sunlight upward, and each sun kept whole shines a bonus beam.
body:
Sun-keepers tend hollow suns that hang over a desert of glass, defending them from sand-bats that descend at noon. The keeper's mirror-gun fires reflected sunlight upward, and each sun kept whole shines a bonus beam.

The rules are simple: the player slides a cannon along the bottom of a 6-column grid, fires upward at 3 rows of descending foes, and scores for every foe cleared before the formation reaches row 10. Clearing a full column without losing ground earns a bonus, and the run ends when the formation lands or is destroyed.

Sand-bats dive fastest at noon, so the keeper shades the suns in rotation, never guarding one sun twice in a row. A sun kept whole through noon shines a beam that clears a column outright.

body:
Shepherds of a signal flock guard messenger-birds that descend from a storm tower. The shepherd's whistle-gun fires upward, and each bird guided home carries a message worth points.

The rules are simple: the player slides a cannon along the bottom of a 7-column grid, fires upward at 2 rows of descending foes, and scores for every foe cleared before the formation reaches row 11. Messenger-birds descend in flocks that scatter when startled, so the shepherd fires sparingly and guides rather than chases. A full flock guided home unlocks a storm-clearing signal that ends the wave.
